text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Saw an 11 mm length off 20 mm round bar, leaving a little to file.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: File both ends flat and square to the bar until it is 11 mm long.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check squareness with an engineer's square on a flat plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Centre punch the bottom end. In a drill press, with the bar held

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: upright in a V-block, drill 5.0 mm, 8 mm deep, and tap M6 8 deep.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The top end stays solid: the accelerometer board is bonded to it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Break the sharp edges lightly; do not round the top face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: an M6 x 12 set screw goes half into the block's left magnet

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: hole and half into the boss, with medium threadlocker. Screw the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: boss down hard so its bottom face sits flat on the block.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The boss rises through the box floor hole and its grommet;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: its top is 3.5 mm above the inside of the box floor.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: boss upright on the block, no rocking, top face flat.
